method: Evaluates temporal information understanding using temporal question answering approaches.
key_assumptions: Temporal QA can assess temporal information understanding.
main_contribution: Provides evaluation frameworks for temporal QA systems.

relation_to_idea.conceptual_difference: Focuses on evaluation of temporal QA systems, while our idea proposes a temporal relevance component for retrieval in versioned regulatory document QA.
relation_to_idea.basis: Title indicates evaluation of temporal information understanding with Temporal QA.
